title: Beginner-Friendly Command-Line Front-End for imuGAP
text: Two input modes. Point imurun directory observations, populations, locations files (CSV RDS, CSV taking precedence), single .xlsx workbook one sheet per input — convenient people work R. Bundled template example workbooks. imurun init drops blank template (correct headers plus instructions sheet) directory; imurun example drops small, complete, runnable example derived imuGAP’s *_sim data. Friendly validation. Inputs checked canonical schema ([IMURUN_SCHEMA]) via layer imuGAP’s canonicalizers names offending sheet, column, row collects every problem can find rather stopping first. Validate-mode. imurun -h <input> checks inputs without fitting, can confirm workbook well-formed committing model run. Fits saves. success runs imuGAP::sampling() writes fit.rds (raw stanfit object) output directory post-processing. Scriptable. engine functions (run_fit(), read_inputs(), validate_inputs(), read_workbook(), friends) exported use directly R, CLI returns shell exit codes (0 success, 1 validation, 2 model, 3 /O) use pipelines.

what: Run the imurun fitting pipeline — run_fit
title: Run the imurun fitting pipeline — run_fit
text: core engine behind imurun command-line interface, exposed ordinary R function. Given directory inputs loads observations locations files (CSV RDS), validates canonical 'imuGAP' schema, fits model imuGAP::sampling(), writes fit.rds output directory. function never throws expected failure modes; instead prints human-readable message returns integer exit code, can drive shell command directly. exit-code taxonomy : 0 Success (usage/validation-request). 1 Input validation failed: schema, invalid unknown command-line option. 2 Model fitting failed. 3 Input/output error (missing directory, unreadable unwritable files).

title: Run the imurun fitting pipeline — run_fit
Run the imurun fitting pipeline — run_fit
text: args character vector command-line style arguments. first non-flag argument input directory; optional second output directory (defaults input directory). leading -h/--help either prints usage (alone) requests validation-mode (followed input directory). Sampler options (--iter, --chains, --seed, --warmup) may appear anywhere override defaults fit; see parse_sampler_options().

title: Run the imurun fitting pipeline — run_fit
text: Invisibly, integer exit code (see Description).

title: Run the imurun fitting pipeline — run_fit
code: # Usage text, no fitting: run_fit(character(0)) #> imurun.R -- Minimal CLI for imuGAP model fitting #>  #> Usage: imurun <input> [output_dir] [sampler options] #>        imurun -h <input>              (validate only, no model fitting) #>        imurun init [dir]              (write a blank input template workbook) #>        imurun example [dir]           (write a filled example workbook) #>        imurun -h | --help             (show this message) #>  #> <input> is either a directory of CSV/RDS files or a single .xlsx workbook. #>  #> A directory must contain: #>   observations.csv (or .rds)      -- columns: obs_id, loc_id, cohort, age_min, age_max, dose, #>                                      positive, sample_n. cohort is the reference cohort, that of #>                                      age_max; a single 'age' column works for a one-age count. #>   locations.csv (or .rds)         -- columns: loc_id, parent_id (hierarchical; see package docs) #>  #> A workbook must have one sheet per input with the same column names #> (run 'imurun init' to get a correctly-headed template). #>  #> Sampler options (each takes a positive whole number; an explicit flag overrides #> the default, otherwise the imuGAP defaults are used): #>   --iter N        total iterations per chain (default 2000) #>   --chains N      number of chains (default 4) #>   --seed N        random seed for reproducibility #>   --warmup N      warmup iterations per chain #> Flags may appear anywhere and may be written --iter N or --iter=N. #>  #> Output: fit.rds (raw stanfit object for post-processing). #> output_dir defaults to input_dir. Exit codes: 0=success, 1=validation, 2=model, 3=I/O.  # Validate inputs only (no Stan toolchain required): dir <- tempfile("imurun_validate_") dir.create(dir) if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Fit and write fit.rds (requires a working Stan toolchain): run_fit("path/to/inputs") } # }

title: imurun 0.1.0
text: Initial release. Exported core CLI engine ordinary R functions: run_fit(), read_inputs(), load_by_ext(), find_input_file(), check_all_inputs(). Added install_cli() put bundled imurun command PATH. Added .xlsx workbook input mode: read_inputs() now accepts either directory CSV/RDS files single workbook one sheet per input, via new read_workbook(). Missing sheets reported . Pinned canonical input schema IMURUN_SCHEMA shipped blank template workbook (inst/templates/imurun_template.xlsx) plus small filled example (inst/extdata/imurun_example.xlsx) derived imuGAP’s *_sim data; resolve imurun_template() / imurun_example(). Added imurun_init() imurun_copy_example() (imurun init / imurun example subcommands) scaffold workbooks directory. Added validate_inputs(), friendly validation layer imuGAP canonicalizers reports every problem spreadsheet terms. Observations now describe inclusive age range (age_min/age_max, labeled Youngest age / Oldest age) rather single age. count covering several ages expands one imuGAP population row per age, weighted equally, ages form observation’s coverage mixture. sheet carrying single age column still read, one-age range. Renamed observations target cohort column Birth cohort Reference cohort, documented cohort row’s oldest age: cohorts younger ages derived age plus cohort stays constant, matching target sheet already expanded. former Birth cohort header still accepted. Set development infrastructure: R CMD check, lint, test coverage, pkgdown, spelling continuous-integration workflows.
